name: find-reasoning-for-task
description: Find successful prior OpenWiki execution traces whose task or outcome resembles the current task, including ordered actions and truncated tool outcomes. Scope with the repository parameter whenever the request names a repository.

config.template: CALL db.index.fulltext.queryNodes('reasoning_memory_search', $query, {limit: 50}) YIELD node AS trace, score WHERE trace.success = true AND ($repository IS NULL OR $repository = '' OR trace.repository = $repository) WITH trace, score ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT $limit OPTIONAL MATCH (trace)-[:HAS_STEP]->(step:ReasoningStep) OPTIONAL MATCH (step)-[:USES_TOOL]->(call:ToolCall) WITH trace, score, step, call ORDER BY score DESC, step.step_number ASC WITH trace, score, step, collect(CASE WHEN call IS NULL THEN null ELSE {tool: call.tool_name, status: call.status, duration_ms: call.duration_ms, arguments: left(call.arguments, 300), result: left(call.result, 300), error: left(call.error, 300)} END) AS raw_calls ORDER BY score DESC, step.step_number ASC WITH trace, score, collect(CASE WHEN step IS NULL THEN null ELSE {step_number: step.step_number, thought: left(step.thought, 500), action: step.action, observation: step.observation, tool_calls: [item IN raw_calls WHERE item IS NOT NULL]} END) AS raw_steps RETURN trace.id AS trace_id, trace.task AS task, left(trace.outcome, 1000) AS outcome, trace.repository AS repository, score, [item IN raw_steps WHERE item IS NOT NULL][0..20] AS steps ORDER BY score DESC

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Plain keywords describing the current OpenWiki task. Do not use quotes, boolean operators, or other Lucene syntax.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description: Exact repository identifier in host/owner/repo form (for example github.com/example/demo-repo). Pass an empty string when the request does not name a repository.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of successful traces to return; use 5 unless the caller asks otherwise. Values above 50 are not honored.

name: recent-reasoning-traces
description: Return the most recent OpenWiki reasoning traces and their ordered execution steps for recency-based fallback memory. Scope with the repository parameter whenever the request names a repository.

config.template: MATCH (trace:ReasoningTrace) WHERE ($success_only = false OR trace.success = true) AND ($repository IS NULL OR $repository = '' OR trace.repository = $repository) WITH trace ORDER BY trace.started_at DESC LIMIT $limit OPTIONAL MATCH (trace)-[:HAS_STEP]->(step:ReasoningStep) OPTIONAL MATCH (step)-[:USES_TOOL]->(call:ToolCall) WITH trace, step, call ORDER BY trace.started_at DESC, step.step_number ASC WITH trace, step, collect(CASE WHEN call IS NULL THEN null ELSE {tool: call.tool_name, status: call.status, duration_ms: call.duration_ms, error: left(call.error, 300)} END) AS raw_calls ORDER BY trace.started_at DESC, step.step_number ASC WITH trace, collect(CASE WHEN step IS NULL THEN null ELSE {step_number: step.step_number, thought: left(step.thought, 500), action: step.action, observation: step.observation, tool_calls: [item IN raw_calls WHERE item IS NOT NULL]} END) AS raw_steps RETURN trace.id AS trace_id, trace.task AS task, left(trace.outcome, 1000) AS outcome, trace.repository AS repository, trace.success AS success, trace.started_at AS started_at, [item IN raw_steps WHERE item IS NOT NULL][0..20] AS steps ORDER BY started_at DESC

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of traces to return; use 5 unless the caller asks otherwise.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description: Exact repository identifier in host/owner/repo form. Pass an empty string when the request does not name a repository.

parameters.name: success_only
parameters.description: True to return only successful traces.

name: last-successful-plan
description: Return the plan text from the most recent successful OpenWiki run of a repository, verbatim. Use when the caller asks for a previously successful plan to adapt.

config.template: MATCH (trace:ReasoningTrace)-[:HAS_STEP]->(step:ReasoningStep) WHERE trace.success = true AND ($repository IS NULL OR $repository = '' OR trace.repository = $repository) AND step.action = 'plan' AND step.thought IS NOT NULL WITH trace, step ORDER BY coalesce(trace.completed_at, trace.started_at) DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN trace.id AS trace_id, trace.repository AS repository, toString(coalesce(trace.completed_at, trace.started_at)) AS completed_at, trace.task AS task, step.thought AS plan

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description: Exact repository identifier in host/owner/repo form. Pass an empty string when the request does not name a repository.

name: openwiki-tool-reliability
description: Rank OpenWiki tools by observed call volume, success rate, failures, and latency.

config.template: MATCH (tool:Tool) RETURN tool.name AS tool, tool.total_calls AS total_calls, tool.successful_calls AS successful_calls, tool.failed_calls AS failed_calls, CASE WHEN tool.total_calls = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE toFloat(tool.successful_calls) / tool.total_calls END AS success_rate, CASE WHEN tool.total_calls = 0 THEN null ELSE toFloat(tool.total_duration_ms) / tool.total_calls END AS avg_duration_ms, tool.last_used_at AS last_used_at ORDER BY total_calls DESC LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tool statistics rows to return; use 10 unless the caller asks otherwise.
